correctness.rationale: For every odd finite field, four distinct reciprocal-even quartic roots form a regular Klein-four torsor; Frobenius has only identity or 2^2 action. A four-to-one parameter map establishes all coefficient frequencies. The even-subset symplectic space has 135 Lagrangians, 105 matchings and 30 affine structures. Invariant matching and affine-subgroup calculations give 135,15,39 rational kernels. The 2^4 Frobenius class includes 8 complement-switched rational classes in J[2], hence both nonsplit cases have 16 rational two-torsion points. Standalone exact code enumerates 135 subgroups and 5934 admissible pairs across fourteen finite fields. The finite verification does not replace the general proof.

value.rationale: The full arithmetic classification of rational (2,2,2)-isogeny kernel choices in this natural two-dimensional family is a geometric-arithmetic invariant. The two nonsplit strata have isomorphic rational two-torsion groups of order 16 but opposite kernel outdegrees 15 and 39; the 30 nonmatching affine-type kernels are essential. Frequencies are exact for all odd q. This is substantive arithmetic descent information rather than a title/parameter substitution or routine small-field enumeration.
